answer.text: In this scenario we have a dated before-and-after comparison of the old hosting setup and a managed handoff. Its owner can check what was actually done, but the comparison has not been cleared for public use.
In this scenario we have no dated comparison, customer permission or measured outcomes. We can describe our intended process, but do not yet have evidence that it worked for a customer.
In this scenario the site has just launched. There are no usable inquiry notes yet and no one has agreed who will check how prospects respond.
For the fictional service, we can answer urgent calls on weekdays in the northern service area. Other calls may reach voicemail. Routine estimates follow a separate process.
